fields.name: numContainedBases
fields.comment: count of extended classes in BaseClassArray (RTTI 2)

fields.name: protOpcode
fields.comment: Init @0x8c120 writes prot->opcode; low byte becomes the first payload byte

fields.name: protSize
fields.comment: -1 = g1 var, -2 = g2 var, else fixed; read back by FUN_000e9540 as the handler size arg

fields.name: bufData
fields.comment: src arg of ClientStream::Write in FlushClientMessages @0x2edb30

fields.name: bufWritePos
fields.comment: incremented per byte written; copied into payloadLength at enqueue time then zeroed

fields.name: prot
fields.comment: ProtEntry back-ptr; prot+0x48 is the eastl::function storage the dispatcher invokes

fields.name: e_lfanew
fields.comment: File address of new exe header
